topics.definition: Ethical hacking is the authorized practice of testing systems to identify and report security weaknesses.
topics.example: Security assessment of a company website
tips: Always obtain written permission before testing.

topics.topic: White Hat, Black Hat and Gray Hat Hackers
topics.definition: White hats work legally to improve security, black hats attack maliciously and gray hats operate between the two.
Reconnaissance gathers information about a target before security testing.
Scanning identifies systems and services, while enumeration gathers detailed information about them.
A vulnerability assessment identifies and prioritizes security weaknesses.
Penetration testing safely simulates attacks to verify whether vulnerabilities can be exploited.
tips: Follow a defined scope and document findings.

topics.definition: Security professionals use tools for scanning, monitoring and analysis during authorized assessments.
tips: Use tools responsibly and only with permission.

topics.definition: Follow legal, ethical and professional standards during every security assessment.
